name: Station Eleven
description: The survivors of a devastating flu attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew – while holding on to the best of what’s been lost.

videos.title: Wheel of Fire
videos.overview: After renowned actor Arthur Leander tragically collapses onstage, Jeevan Chaudhary and young Kirsten Raymonde have a chance meeting – and soon face an important decision that could save their lives.

videos.title: A Hawk from a Handsaw
videos.overview: Twenty years later, Kirsten and her Shakespearean troupe, the Traveling Symphony, meet a mysterious man on their way to perform at St. Deborah-by-the-Water.

videos.title: Hurricane
videos.overview: While fighting for her only chance at survival, Miranda Carroll reflects on the cost of her relationships with Arthur and Dr. Eleven.

videos.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Aren’t Dead
videos.overview: After Kirsten nudges the Traveling Symphony off-course to help unravel the mystery of the Prophet, a much grimmer truth is revealed.

videos.title: The Severn City Airport
videos.overview: After an unexpected landing in Severn City, Arthur’s ex-wife Elizabeth, son Tyler, and friend Clark confront an even more uncertain future.

videos.title: Survival is Insufficient
videos.overview: While Kirsten leaves the Traveling Symphony behind to track down the Prophet, the Conductor accepts an invitation for the rest of the grieving troupe that breaks her heart.

videos.title: Goodbye My Damaged Home
videos.overview: On a journey to unravel her deepest trauma, Kirsten goes back to the apartment she once shared with Jeevan and Frank.

videos.title: Who’s There?
videos.overview: Kirsten arrives in Severn City to rescue the Traveling Symphony - only to find herself trapped in a family conflict that began twenty years ago.

videos.title: Dr. Chaudhary
videos.overview: Jeevan and Kirsten survive their first winter alone until an argument sends Jeevan on an unexpected path.

videos.title: Unbroken Circle
videos.overview: Kirsten sets in motion her plan to free the Traveling Symphony, while Miranda tries to live the right life.

awards: Nominated for 7 Primetime Emmys. 10 wins & 36 nominations total
